english.title: Pilot fly aircraft over congested area below required height
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) failed to comply with rule 3105 of the Standardised European Rules of the Air, in that the aircraft, namely **(..DESCRIBE AIRCRAFT AND REGISTRATION..), flew over

(A)_[the congested area of a city, town or settlement]_
(B)_[an open-air assembly of persons]_

at a height that was less than would permit, in the event of an emergency arising, a landing to be made without undue hazard to persons or property on the surface
english.legislation: Contrary to rule 3105 of the Standardised European Rules of the Air, Article 265(6) of, and Part 2 of Schedule 13 to, the Air Navigation Order 2016.
